title: Inside Account Executive
teaser: We are expanding our team: As an Inside Account Executive, you will drive AI infrastructure investment across ASEAN, focusing on multi-national and SME segments. You will qualify and manage sales opportunities, engage with customers, and support cross-functional teams. Ideal for candidates with extensive sales experience in ASEAN and strong networking expertise.
description:
We are looking for a pursuit Account Executive to capture the increasing AI infrastructure investment especially in the multi-national segment. The ideal candidate must possess extensive sales experience across multiple markets in ASEAN.

The relevant sales experience with Chinese-headquartered clients is a plus. Qualifies and progresses sales opportunities within a broad geographic territory covering both Small and Medium Business (SMB), Mid-Market segments and Multinationals (MNCs).

Processes a high volume of virtual transactions, engaging directly with a select subset of customers to validate opportunities and ensure sufficient resource allocation. Serves as an opportunity facilitator, receiving and managing inbound opportunities from partners, marketing teams, and Sales Development Representatives (SDRs).

Maintains a comprehensive understanding of Cisco’s full product portfolio to deliver the “One Cisco Story”.

Engages specialist teams to enhance the sales process in areas requiring deep technical expertise.

Aids in moving deals down the sales funnel by qualifying opportunities and holding partners accountable to manage and close deals.

Analyzes data and creates accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales forecasts. Stays informed about industry trends, market dynamics, and competitive landscapes

Specialization and Focus - 

Generalist, with knowledge of the full product portfolio and a focus on Networking and Security.

Operates as a unit with team members in an iAE pod. Strong ability to coordinate on strategy, education, and sales to scale reach and delivery within a shared set of Mid-Market and SMB accounts

• Customer Engagement and Accountability - 

May interact with customers or partners through the qualifying process •

The Internal Sales Process - Spends most of the time prospecting, may re-enter the sales process to support deal agreement and closing

What You'll Do: 

Identify and qualify complex sales opportunities with ASEAN with a focus on AI infrastructure and MNC segments

Cultivates collaboration across the pod to stay informed and identify when to engage team members at any given time to maximize opportunities

Take the lead with our specialist sales teams to drive One Cisco messaging and penetrate broader Cisco portfolio

Provides critical input to cross-architecture initiatives to optimize strategic opportunities across the pod

Engages and manages Mid-Market, SMB, and MNC accounts using RAD data and AI tools to drive customer acquisition and retention through effective cross-pod coordination

Develops in-depth understanding of customer(s), product(s), organization, industry, challenges, to align Cisco’s solutions with decision-makers; researches other relevant solutions as required

Empowers partners with market analysis and strategic support to enhance opportunity targeting and build a strong Mid-Market pipeline Facilitates workshops and strategic planning sessions with multiple customer stakeholders

Provides Partners with tools and resources to deliver multi-technology, cross-architecture solutions

Leverages outbound marketing campaign content and insights to aid Partners in tailoring outreach efforts

Delivers strategic insights that influence deal direction

Combines advanced knowledge of a primary Cisco portfolio with working knowledge of other Cisco architectures

Collaborates with partners and cross-functional teams to support design and proposal of advanced, customized solutions that address nuanced customer needs

Facilitates technical discussions with customer IT and business leaders to co-develop solution roadmaps

Uses standard and occasional non-standard methods to describe Cisco’s solution value and address customer challenges in discovery conversations

Ensures real-time updates across deal stages, legal forecasts, and key customer interactions through consistent virtual connection with partners •

Collaborates with finance to accelerate deal closure and resolve complex issues

Influences partners and team members by shaping strategies and providing Networking portfolio expertise

Operationalizes knowledge sharing, leveraging informal and formal channels to foster collaboration and drive a culture of continuous learning and innovation amongst partners and the pod

Minimum Qualifications: 

Bachelors + 8 years of related experience

Bi-lingual in English and Mandarin Chinese

Preferred Qualifications: Varies based on the team and business needs | Preferred Qualifications are desired education, experience, and skills that are in addition to Minimum Qualifications. THIS JOB DESCRIPTION DOES NOT APPLY FOR EMPLOYEES IN AUSTRIA, BELGIUM, FRANCE, GERMANY & NETHERLANDS
